description: Anonymous, best-effort recorded events, not a census: opted-out, CI, excluded and offline runs may be absent. The public ingestion endpoint can receive forged valid events. Queries are capped at 180 days. Manual refresh; displayed values and event age reflect the last successful query, not a live clock. Inspect native query errors for denied access, missing table, timeout or throttling; failed or loading observations are not zero usage or service health.

panels.description: Accepted records matching the selected time range and filters, not people or installations. Observation text distinguishes a successful empty time range from filters matching no records. Query failures must remain native errors, not zero counts.
panels.title: Recorded Command Events

panels.description: Timestamp and age at the last query within the selected scope. Refresh manually to recalculate age; Query observed at identifies the last successful query, including empty results. Compare it with the current time to recognize stale displayed observations. Timestamps use the selected browser timezone. The absence of events alone is not proof of service outage.
panels.title: Latest Matching Event

panels.description: Counts and share labeled as nonzero exits; Outcome = failure also includes expected exit-2 states and is not a crash/error rate
panels.title: Nonzero Exit Outcomes

panels.description: Time-bucketed command-event counts using server-generated timestamps
panels.title: Event Volume Over Time

panels.description: Ranked counts for actual recorded command values
panels.title: Events by Command

panels.description: Observed version distribution, not an installation inventory or native-channel attribution
panels.title: Events by CLI Version

list.definition: All commands, or one of the first 100 observed command values in the selected time range
list.description: Filter events by canonical command name.
list.label: Command
list.name: command

azureLogAnalytics.query:
union (print Command = "All"), (LiftoffCommandEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(180d)
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| distinct Command
| top 100 by Command asc)
| order by Command asc

query.rawQuery:

| where TimeGenerated >= ago(180d)
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| distinct Command
| top 100 by Command asc)
| order by Command asc
